name: FSL Brain Extraction (BET) on fMRI
summary: Removes non-brain tissue from a 4D BOLD fMRI series with FSL BET (-F, applied to every volume) and outputs the masked bold.nii.gz and a brain mask.
description: Runs FSL bet with -F -m on bold.nii.gz so the brain mask is estimated from the functional series and applied to all volumes. Use it to skull-strip functional data before analyses that need brain-only voxels. The output keeps the other files of the func/task input and replaces bold.nii.gz with the masked series. Adjust fthreshold if the mask is too tight or too loose.

inputs.description: 4D BOLD fMRI task datatype; the bold.nii.gz image is brain-extracted.

outputs.description: masked bold.nii.gz.. only bold.nii.gz is copied from the input (no events.tsv, etc..)
Binary brain mask (mask.nii.gz) produced by BET from the BOLD series.

parameters.description: choose the fractional intensity threshold (0 -> 1); default=0.4; smaller values give larger brain outline estimates
